notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's row in NBIM's year-end 2024 holdings data file ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); the same line in NBIM's equity CSV download (https://www.nbim.no/api/investments/v2/report/?assetType=eq&date=2024-12-31&fileType=csv) reads "North America;United States;Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc;Consumer Discretionary;12445488242;1095809167;1.33%;1.33%". CalPERS: the source is CalPERS's 13F-HR/A (restatement) for the quarter ended December 31, 2024, filed April 23, 2025; its information table is identical to the original 13F-HR filed February 12, 2025. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS: Chipotle's 10-K cover page reads "1,355,337 shares" outstanding at January 31, 2025, which omits the thousands (the balance sheet is in thousands and weighted-average basic shares were 1,368,343 thousand), so the denominator is the balance sheet: 1,358,751 thousand shares issued and no treasury shares at December 31, 2024.
